name: Ancient Blade (Heirloom Katana Detail)
description: Legendary 3D showcase of a centuries-old masterwork katana. A razor-sharp folded steel blade with a dramatic undulating wavy hamon temper line, antique gold dragon tsuba handguard, and black rayskin grip wrapped in crimson silk cord on a dark lacquer stand.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of an ancient legendary samurai katana blade. A razor-sharp curved folded steel blade with glowing wavy white-and-red hamon temper line, antique gold dragon tsuba guard, and black rayskin hilt wrapped in deep crimson red (#FF2035) silk cord, resting on a pitch-black lacquer sword rack. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), dramatic crimson edge lighting, 8k render, no text.
